brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted a raid on al-Mugheir village, located northeast of Ramallah, on Saturday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The incursion marked the latest military operation in the occupied West Bank, where such raids have occurred with frequency in recent months.

The forces entered the village during evening hours. No immediate statements were released regarding the stated purpose of the operation, the duration of the deployment, or whether troops remained in the area following the initial incursion. Local residents and Palestinian officials did not immediately issue public statements about the raid.
